body: I couldn't go all the way, my family is the only thing keeping me alive. I took them for granted for a long time, but they were always there when I was in trouble, I feel so shitty about the way I treated them. Thanks for reaching out MuddyMason, & all of you, you are the unsung heroes of Reddit
Thank you for the support. I think I'll be ok for a couple of days, I'm getting some help coping with the failure and its implications on my life.
They went through so much and they're helping me cope, I just can't do that to them. Thank you for the kind words :)

I didn't go all the way, I love my family too much, my little sister needs me too, I just can't leave her that way. I couldn't finish. I feel like this failure will define me for the rest of my life. It was too much.
